schema.description: An intra-site move of one SKU between two bins of the same site (ADR 0039). Both bins must be registered and belong to siteCode: their recorded site custody, or, when none is recorded, the site segment of a facility-layout location code (site-area-zone-aisle-bay-level-position).

siteCode.description: The site both bins must be in.

fromBin.description: Source bin. Only its usable (unreserved) quantity of the SKU moves.

toBin.description: Destination bin; must differ from fromBin and have room for quantity.

reason.description: Why the stock moves. Absent means MANUAL.

sourceRef.description: The caller's correlation (a slot-plan move, a ticket). Optional.

schema.title: RelocateStockRequest
